record.original_question: Let Ω be either a sphere S^d or a projective space FP^d equipped with a distance ρ equivalent to the geodesic distance, and let S(Ω) be the set of s for which the uniform probability measure σ minimizes the Riesz energy I_s. If σ minimizes I_{s*} for some s*>0, does it follow that σ also minimizes I_s for every s with s*<s<d? Equivalently, must S(Ω) remain connected in the positive-s regime?

evidence.quote: Question 5.1 (Peter Grabner). Is the following statement true: let s∗ > 0 such that σ is minimizer of Is∗ , then it is a minimizer for all s∗ < s < d.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega$ be either the unit sphere $S^d \subset \mathbb{R}^{d+1}$ or a projective space $\mathbb{F}P^d$ (with $\mathbb{F} \in \{\mathbb{R}, \mathbb{C}, \mathbb{H}\}$, or the Cayley plane when $d=2$, $\mathbb{F}=\mathbb{O}$), and let $\rho$ be a metric on $\Omega$ that is bi-Lipschitz equivalent to the geodesic distance. Let $\sigma$ denote the unique normalized Riemannian (uniform) probability measure on $\Omega$. For a real parameter $s$, define the Riesz $s$-energy of a Borel probability measure $\mu$ on $\Omega$ by
$$I_s(\mu) = \iint_{\Omega \times \Omega} \rho(x,y)^{-s}\, d\mu(x)\, d\mu(y),$$
with the usual convention for $s\le 0$ (replacing $\rho^{-s}$ by $-\rho^{-s}$ or using logarithmic kernels at $s=0$). Define
$$S(\Omega) = \{\, s \in \mathbb{R} : \sigma \text{ minimizes } I_s \text{ over all Borel probability measures on } \Omega \,\}.$$
Suppose there exists $s^* > 0$ such that $\sigma$ is a minimizer of $I_{s^*}$. Must $\sigma$ then be a minimizer of $I_s$ for every $s$ with $s^* < s < d$? Equivalently, must the set $S(\Omega) \cap (0, d)$ be connected (i.e., an interval)?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem by Peter Grabner in a recent collection of open problems. A web search did not turn up a published resolution; related recent work (e.g., on geodesic-distance Riesz energy on projective spaces) studies the structure of $S(\Omega)$ but does not establish connectedness of its positive part. The status appears to be open.

status_evidence.title: Geodesic distance Riesz energy on projective spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the set of s for which the uniform measure minimizes Riesz s-energy on projective spaces; does not resolve connectedness of S(Ω).
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature on the structure of S(Ω) for projective spaces does not contain a proof that S(Ω) is connected on (0,d).

status_evidence.title: Distributing many points on spheres: minimal energy and designs
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on minimal Riesz energy on spheres including discussion of regimes of s where σ is a minimizer.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys of minimal Riesz energy on spheres treat connectedness of the minimizing-s set as an unresolved structural question.
